name: Ladderup Finance Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2008, Ladderup Finance 
Ltd is in the business of financing and 
investments[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
Company is in the business of investing in securities of listed and unlisted companies, predominantly for the medium to long term. The Company’s investment portfolio is diversified across various sectors, viz. financial services, healthcare, retail, packaging, QSR, information technology and real estate, etc. It deals in Investment Banking, Capital Markets, Wealth Management, Project Finance, and growth 
 stage investing.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.76 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 147 days to 27.2 days
cons: Company has a low return on equity of -2.23% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.5.11 Cr.
